title: Grateful Dead Live at Roosevelt Stadium on 1972-07-18
source: 2 Source Matrix by Dusborne; Recording Info: SBD -> Master Reel -> Cassette -> Dat -> CD; Transfer Info: CD -> Samplitude Professional v7.02 -> Cool Edit Pro v2.0 -> FLAC; and AUDMC>?>R>D>SHN>CDR

ai_review.summary: Exceptional matrix recording of a legendary July 1972 show featuring a jazzy Dark Star, massive setlist and sky‑high energy.
ai_review.review: The performance is hailed as one of the best ’72 shows, with a soaring Dark Star, a gorgeous Comes A Time segue and an unforgettable closing Not Fade Away → Good Times → Not Fade Away sequence. The MTX (soundboard/audience splice) sounds modern‑era crisp and clean, making the historic setlist a joy to hear.

ai_rating.rationale: All five reviewers gave 5‑star ratings, praising both the musical performance and the superb matrix recording; the consensus is overwhelmingly positive.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Soundboard/audience splice praised as crisp, modern‑era quality with no notable dropouts; overall clarity and balance are outstanding.

standout_songs: Not Fade Away → Good Times → Not Fade Away (closing sequence)
show_quality.setlist_flow: Massive setlist flows smoothly, highlighted by a jazzy Dark Star and an astonishing closing triple‑song peel that left the audience in disbelief.
